source_replay.details: All nine complete source banks replay faithfully; canonical cosine equation and solution match. The duplicated equivalent sine source answer is documented, and its repaired profile passes.

variety.details: 60 fresh samples cover nine templates. All survive matching-difficulty delivery; all five runner records survive. Selection support was examined under the supplied rules and stated weight/history conditions. No affected generated inventory instances demonstrated.

scope.details: Variations retain the response contract, integrating-factor method and source-supported workload.

grading.details: Native grader matches 160 expected acceptances and 492 rejections across 80 records. Both fields and every choice were tested independently. Free entry is inapplicable.

rendering.details: Actual UI rendered 18 records without reported errors. Representative screenshots across all templates and controlled pairs show legible notation, controls and solutions.

packaging.details: Exact dependency versions match. Deterministic replay, relocation and six invalid-input rejection cases pass. Package hashes are unchanged.

decision_variation.details: Relevant and irrelevant controlled changes behave correctly through grading and rendering. Template-conditional position, length and numeric-rank probes demonstrate no reproducible incidental predictor. Finite-sample and captured-state limits are recorded.
